message:
Users now have an optional nickname. `createUser` accepts it, and `getUser` returns it, or `null` when it isn't set. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including both in `test/users-nickname.test.js`.

The users table had no `nickname` column, so I added one with a new migration, `migrations/003_add_nickname.js`. I didn't edit migrations 001 or 002, which are already applied in production. `migrations/` is marked as owned by the DBA team, so that team should look at the new migration before it ships.

The changes are in `src/api/users.js` and the new migration file. Nothing was committed.
